v start suddenly, as from fright
v throw quickly
shied.translation: v. （指马）惊退；后退；回避；厌恶（shy的过去分词形式）

shief.translation: abbr. shared information elicitation facility 共享信息启发设备

shiel.translation:
n. (Shiel)人名；(英)希尔

shield.definition:
n. a protective covering or structure
n. armor carried on the arm to intercept blows
v. protect, hide, or conceal from danger or harm
shield.translation:
n. 盾, 防卫物, 保护者, 屏蔽
vt. 保护, 遮蔽, 屏蔽, 庇护, 挡开, 避开
vi. 起保护作用

shield of david.translation:
na. 大卫王的盾牌
[网络] 大卫之盾；大卫王之盾；大卫盾

shield-shaped.definition: s (of a leaf shape) round, with the stem attached near the center of the lower surface rather than the margin (as a nasturtium leaf for example)

shielded.definition: s. (used especially of machinery) protected by a shield to prevent injury
shielded.translation: a. 隔离的；屏蔽了的；防护的；铠装的

shielded cable.translation:
[计] 屏蔽电缆, 屏蔽线
[医] 屏蔽电缆

shielded electrode.translation: [医] 保护电极, 屏护电极

shielded inert-gas metal arc welding.translation: [化] 惰性气体保护金属电弧焊

shielded metal arc welding.translation: [化] 自动保护金属极电弧焊

shielder.definition: n. a person who cares for persons or property
shielder.translation: n. 盾；防护物；保护者 (shield的变形)

shielding.definition:
n. the act of shielding from harm
n. a shield of lead or concrete intended as a barrier to radiation emitted in nuclear decay
n. shield consisting of an arrangement of metal mesh or plates designed to protect electronic equipment from ambient electromagnetic interference
shielding.translation:
[计] 屏幕, 掩盖, 隔离
[化] 屏蔽

shielding gas.translation: [化] 保护气; 保护气体

shieldless.definition: a. Destitute of a shield, or of protection.

shields.definition:
n a protective covering or structure
n armor carried on the arm to intercept blows
n hard outer covering or case of certain organisms such as arthropods and turtles
v protect, hide, or conceal from danger or harm
v hold back a thought or feeling about
shields.translation: n. 盾, 防卫物（shield的复数形式）

shieldtail.definition:
n. Any species of small burrowing snakes of the family
   Uropeltidae, native of Ceylon and Southern Asia. They have a small
   mouth which can not be dilated.

shieling.definition: n. A hut or shelter for shepherds of fishers. See Sheeling.
shieling.translation: n. 草棚, 茅屋, 运动员更衣棚, 运动员休息棚, 羊栏, 羊圈

shielings.definition:
plural of shieling
n. A hut or shelter for shepherds of fishers. See Sheeling.
shielings.translation: (shieling 的复数) n. 草棚, 茅屋, 运动员更衣棚, 运动员休息棚, 羊栏, 羊圈

shiels.definition:
plural of Shiel
n. A sheeling.
shiels.translation:
(Shiel 的复数) n. (Shiel)人名；(英)希尔
希尔（人名）

shiels method.translation: [医] 薛尔斯氏法(血液胆甾醇定量)
